Subject: Project Update: Revised Delivery Date of 14 April

I'm writing to share an update on the project timeline. The third-party integration required for the platform has taken longer than expected to complete certification, and as a result the schedule has moved by two weeks. We are working closely with the certifying party to keep this process moving and to prevent any further slippage.

Based on this revised timeline, the new delivery date is 14 April. We are confident this date reflects the additional time needed to complete certification properly and to deliver a fully tested, reliable integration rather than rushing a step that affects the stability of the final product.

Does this revised date of 14 April work with your internal planning and any dependent milestones on your side? Please let us know if there are constraints we should be aware of, and we will keep you updated on certification progress as we approach the new delivery date.
